subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf raised by hill giants, struggling to reconcile his dual heritage and seeking acceptance into a dwarven clan. He is emotionally grounded by his bond with Dawnbringer and has formed deep, unspoken alliances with his companions after surviving the Underdark.
source_quote: I'm a dwarf. I'm not invited along.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth is a dwarven noble bound by duty to report the dangers of the Underdark to Mithral Hall and Gauntlgrym. She recognizes Thorin’s worth beyond clan norms and has sworn to formally embrace him into her clan after delivering her briefing.
source_quote: I swear.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a sentient magical sword with agency, warmth, and a personality shaped by months of darkness and now the open sky. She shares a profound, non-verbal bond with Thorin and is unapologetically self-aware, even when called annoying.
source_quote: I'm annoying also, Dawnbringer. Look, you know, we got each other.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a former Ember Vanguard monk trained in reading environmental stillness and threat vectors. He remains hyper-vigilant after months underground and has developed a quiet, wordless rapport with his companions, especially in moments of danger.
source_quote: The deer.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is an ooze with unexpected sentience and capacity for witness. Despite lacking fixed appendages or conventional mobility, he demonstrates focused stillness and awareness, prompting Zalthir to consider him as a potential monk candidate.
source_quote: Glabbagool just looked up.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait is a goblin who has never been to the surface and is navigating social integration with cautious optimism. He seeks safety through proximity to larger, more accepted companions rather than direct confrontation with prejudice.
source_quote: Do you mind if I just sort of hang out with you guys?

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a methodical, observant companion who relies on precision and analysis. He shares Zalthir’s awareness of environmental anomalies and contributes to the group’s silent consensus on threats.
source_quote: Daz squinted and pushed his spectacles up and looked like a man calculating the precise angle of the light source.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a pragmatic, dice-rolling companion whose confidence often masks deep intuition. He is protective of small or vulnerable beings and serves as the group’s emotional anchor in moments of tension.
source_quote: You conclude, that what is following you is a deer.

subject: Clan of Mithral Hall
fact: The dwarven clan of Mithral Hall holds authority over surface knowledge of the Underdark and is the intended recipient of Eldeth’s report. They are perceived as gatekeepers of tradition, but Eldeth believes they will extend inclusion to Thorin once the truth is presented.
source_quote: I am certain they will want to speak to you, and I will make it a statement of purpose that you shall be embraced by our clan.

subject: Ember Vanguard
fact: The Ember Vanguard is a monastic order with specialized training in environmental threat detection and silent communication. Zalthir’s training within this order enables the group to recognize covert surveillance without verbal confirmation.
source_quote: The three of you quickly realize... that somebody's following you.

subject: departure from Candlekeep's tunnel
fact: The group emerges from the Underdark into sunlight at Candlekeep’s tunnel mouth, marking the end of their subterranean journey and the beginning of their transition to the surface world. Each member reacts differently, reflecting their trauma, hope, and adaptation.
source_quote: The sun. I keep coming back to that first moment of it...

subject: Eldeth’s oath to Thorin
fact: Eldeth formally swears to secure Thorin’s acceptance into her clan after delivering her report to the dwarven lords, transforming what could have been a farewell into a promise of belonging.
source_quote: I swear.

subject: detection of hidden pursuer
fact: On the third day of surface travel, Zalthir and his companions detect a silent, patient follower in the northern treeline — an entity that mimics natural stillness and has been tracking them since emerging from the Underdark.
source_quote: The trees north of us were wrong.

subject: Candlekeep
fact: Candlekeep is a landmark on the surface, situated west of the Underdark exit, serving as a neutral ground and potential sanctuary. It is referenced as a destination for both Eldeth’s journey and Spiderbait’s hope for safety.
source_quote: Head west and you'll hit Candlekeep.

subject: Mithral Hall
fact: Mithral Hall is a dwarven stronghold and political center where Eldeth must deliver her report on the Underdark’s dangers. It represents the threshold between the hidden world and surface authority, and the potential gateway to Thorin’s acceptance.
source_quote: I must go to Mithral Hall.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a sentient, warm-hilted magical sword that radiates emotional resonance. It is not merely a weapon but a companion with personality, history, and agency — capable of affection, sarcasm, and silent understanding.
source_quote: I'm annoying also, Dawnbringer.

subject: Hidden pursuer
fact: An unidentified entity is following the group with expert patience, using terrain and timing to remain undetected. It moves with intention, avoiding detection even from trained observers, and is not a deer despite Grygum’s roll.
source_quote: Oh, no. It's not a deer.

subject: Thorin’s dwarven identity
fact: Thorin’s journey to reconcile his giant upbringing with his dwarven heritage remains unresolved. Eldeth’s oath offers a path, but whether the clan will accept him — and how he will define himself — is an open thread.
source_quote: I do want to learn about my dwarven roots.

subject: the pursuer’s identity
fact: The identity, motive, and origin of the hidden follower remain unknown. Its presence suggests deeper, surface-level threats connected to Underdark events — a looming danger not yet named.
source_quote: Whatever was in those trees had been moving with us... Patient.

subject: Glabbagool’s monk potential
fact: Zalthir’s contemplation of Glabbagool as a monk candidate introduces an unprecedented question: can an ooze embody discipline, stillness, and spiritual growth? This thread challenges traditional definitions of monasticism.
source_quote: He's got the stillness working for him.

subject: third day of open sky
fact: The events of the hidden pursuer’s detection occur on the third day after emerging from the Underdark, marking a psychological transition point where surface normalcy begins to fray under lingering trauma.
source_quote: The third day of open sky and I still hadn't stopped scanning.

subject: dusk
fact: The pursuer is detected at dusk — a time of diminished visibility and heightened vulnerability — which the entity appears to have chosen deliberately or stumbled into through patience.
source_quote: Dusk came in from the west...
